Pros- lovely light rose scent, very moisturizing, strong actives but still gentle enough for daily use on its own, lasts a long time, doesn’t give that weird sticky layer that I always get with water based versions.Cons- Strong enough that if you forget sunscreen and go out in direct sunlight you will sorely regret it. Also as someone who’s dry in winter and oily in summer it takes some rearranging to fit it into my skincare routine.Overall this is a great product if you have a way to incorporate an oil into your skincare routine daily and you’re good about sunscreen use. I also like that this doesn’t leave the weird filmy feeling I always seem to get from water based C serums. However, your best value is going to be had in the “hydration hits” set with the .4 oz size. sku_or_module: Tatcha - Gold Camellia Beauty Oil
redacted_text: I have collected about every Tatcha product from Sephora this year. Tatcha is a wonderful product. The Gold Camellia Beauty Oil would be wonderful for dryer skin as I have about every line out there and switch them up during the week. This product does make your face feel soft and it melts right into your skin. The product does have a pump on top that you need to use very little as it does go a long way. If you use too much it will leave your skin feeling oily and heavy. This bottle would last me at least a year or more if I used it daily. The tiny Gold flakes are nice mixed with the Camellia. It is a bit on the pricey side however, don’t let the price tag fool you, it will last longer than one would think. The product goes well with my other Tatcha products I purchased with this order. The Gold Camellia Beauty Oil is beautifully packaged. I believe the product would be cheaper if the product line stopped the “gift look“ packaging. Over all this is a wonderful Beauty Oil however, the oil isn’t for me as much as I wanted to love it.I am 50 years old have some wrinkles not too bad as I have used high end brands for the past 6-7 years. I would say my face is normal more so than oily, combination or dry. The only place I notice is oily without any product is around my nostrils. When I applied a small amount of the Tatcha Gold Camellia Beauty Oil the product did soak into my skin. The product felt very heavy leaving a thick oil all over my face, I used about two pea sizes for my entire face and neck. I live in Arkansas where it’s not only hot in the Summer time but the humidity is very high and sticky. I left the product on my face half of the day using blotting paper, tissues all day trying to absorb the oil from my eyelids and nostrils. I had to wash my face with my Estee Lauder Perfectly clean face wash using my mia3 and it still felt oily. I waited for about an hour washed my face this time using Algenist face wash. I’ve skipped the last two days/nights without using any product and it still feels oily along with our high humidity. This product may be fine for those have no oily issues what so ever, i really have none but using this product sadly my face felt like I used the whole bottle. If you live in an area with high humidity I don’t recommend this product. If you have no oil issues and live in an area with less humidity this product may work for you. I have not used it on my hair as I am [REDACTED_NAME] product as much as I don’t want too. I use the JM Argan oil as I’ve used one bottle and just re-ordered another with this purchase. I have no problems with any of the other Tatcha products as I will write my review on the Tatcha Bestsellers Set, absolutely love it! sku_or_module: The Ordinary - Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% Oil Control Serum
redacted_text: I LOVE this product and use it every day, morning and night. The bottom line, if you don’t want to read the detailed review is this:-keeps congestion at bay-prevents my hard cystic period zits for 2 years and going-doesn’t pill under lotion or makeup -suuuper affordable-pores look smaller I tend to be drier, but will get micro-congestion on my chin, nose and jawline and sometimes my skin can be a little sensitive. Before i started using this product, i would also get those deep, welt-like zits that feel like a lump and take forever to come to surface around my period. I started using this during one of those times. I will say the first couple applications stung a little, but just first couple. At first my chin got slightly worse, with little blemishes coming to the surface, but i persisted, and i’m glad I did! The first 3 days, using this serum under my usual moisturizer/sunscreen were filled with anxiety as my chin was getting so angry and it seemed like my giant zit was recruiting tiny friends lol, but when I woke up on day 4, my chin looked like someone took an eraser over it, my pores were so tiny and smooth, and the big guy was smoother, smaller and no longer red. By the end of the week, the big chin zit was completely gone and never came to a gross head. Just shrunk and disappeared. Since then with daily use as my first step of skincare, i have not had one of those hard zits during my period or otherwise and it’s been 2 years of use. I also use it after workouts on freshly washed skin to calm it a little and that seems to help prevent workout related breakouts, at least for my combo-dry skin. I do only really apply to the T zone and jaw line and use a lentil/small pea sized amount on freshly washed skin that is still a teeny bit damp. You don’t need a lot, or the excess will just pill-off, but I haven’t had problems with pilling. Try the small bottle if you’re curious, if for no other reason than it’s affordable and can work.

redacted_text: I never write reviews, but I’m purchasing my 7th bottle (and it’s not cheap!) soooo that might let you know how I feel about this product. What I noticed was a gradual reduction in my stress levels over time, which helped me deal with work “emergencies”  in a calm manner. I’ve been in my job for several years and I can attest to the fact that I was much more grounded and less panicked/stressed than I have been in prior busy seasons. It took at least two weeks for me to notice anything different, and between 6-8 weeks for me to decide if it was working. I take two pills in the morning on weekdays, and then on weekends I’ll take one pill. I really appreciate this product, just wish it was cheaper :)

sku_or_module: Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare - Hyaluronic Marine Dew It Right Eye Gel
redacted_text: The Hyaluronic Marine Dew It Right Eye Gel from Dr. Dennis Gross Skincare is a good lightweight eye cream, but given the price and statements I wasn’t overly impressed. The consistency is more like cream-gel that gets absorbed into skin very fast. I have combination skin, but dry under eyes; this eye gel keeps my under eye area hydrated without making it greasy, but I sometimes felt the need of something more moisturizing (and up to 72 hours hydration is not a true claim). I didn’t noticed any impact on dark circles and puffiness, but it helps with the look of fine lines and under eye wrinkles (due to the smoothness effect). I’m using the same amount of concealer, but it sits well under make-up (doesn’t make concealer look patchy or apply bad). The cream didn’t irritate my very sensitive eyes. The packaging is very practical, I love that it gets up and I know how much product I got left. Sometimes the pump gets stuck and I needed to push multiple times until product finally comes out; and for a $48 eye cream, the plastic packaging is not a nice touch. The pump dispenses more product that I need for under eye, but for me it’s fine, since I spread some product on my forehead and on my smile lines as well.

sku_or_module: The Ordinary - Mandelic Acid 10% + HA
redacted_text: Before I talk specifically about this product, I have to go back to “the beginning“. Previously, I was using professional products recommended by a licensed, International award winning esthetician. Not trying to sound pompous and braggy - it’s just what I was working with. My skincare was comprised of that skincare system, and I would occasionally supplement things like moisturizers and masks. Mandelic acid is one of my FAVORITE ingredients. Not only was it a founding ingredient in the skincare products I was using, but you can also find it in products like Lume deodorant (another product I LITERALLY LOVE). Long story short, after trying The [REDACTED_ORDER_ID]’s face peel (you know, the red one), I was really open to trying more of their products especially because the price is so much better than the professional products I was buying. If they work just as good or better, I’m certainly willing to switch and I LOVE a deal. This product has a lower percentage of Mandelic acid than what I’ve previously been using. So for me, it wasn’t harsh or irritating. Most people find this pretty gentle. My problem with it is that it contains glycerin. I don’t believe any of my other serums contain glycerin, so when I put this on... it almost feels oily. I’ve tried to work around it and make this the last serum that I use, but I think this COULD cause breakouts and problems for other people. Because of the glycerin and the oily feeling, it’s definitely NOT my favorite serum. I do believe in Mandelic Acid. I think this could help people, but I think just as many people will have issues with it so people should be wary.

sku_or_module: SOBEL SKIN Rx - 30% Glycolic Acid Peel Concentrate
redacted_text: I’ve finally found a way in which this product works best for me. I’m not good at following the rules but I did start out at 2 minutes. I upped the minutes as time went by but was not all that impressed with the results.  So, and I don’t necessarily recommend this unless you totally know your skin, I started using it with my favorite masks 2x a week. I’d swipe it on and then apply the mask on top. I usually leave it on for 30 minutes before removing. With this method, I’m seeing the results I’ve expected. My pores appear smaller, skin is much smoother (no more orange peel) and my hyperpigmentation is slowly going away. I use 3 different masks, not at the same time of course, and rotate them each time.  My skin is acclimated to this type of treatment so I’ve not experienced any side effects.

sku_or_module: Murad - Acne Control Clarifying Cleanser
redacted_text: I’ve had acne since puberty (10 or 11), but got on birth control and started using Epiduo once I got to college, which helped clear up my skin A BUNCH, but like too much of anything, my skin became used to it and started getting worse after a couple years, but never bad enough to complain about.Until about 6 or 7 months ago, my acne has largely consisted of blackheads all over my nose and on the majority of my chin (easily covered with make-up, but nothing ever works to get rid of them) with a few bumps (usually 2-4 at one time) around my mouth and nose and an occasional few on the forehead. In general, my skin is usually oily, but can have dry spots when old acne is healing.Then, something changed. I’m not sure what triggered it but I started getting painful, cystic acne and cluster acne on my cheeks, something that had NEVER happened. My skin was changing for the worse and I was 22.I decided to shell out the money and try the Clarifying Cleanser (with a Clarisonic) and after the first month, my skin did a complete 180.Here is my new regimen: Murad Clarifying Skin Supplements (2 twice a day)Murad Clarifying Cleanser (Twice a day with a Clarisonic Mia brush)Vitamins: (1) Zinc pill (1) E-400iu pill(I also try to drink 96 oz of water each day) The combination of the pills and using the cleanser with the Clarisonic is what I think did the trick! I’ve been using it a little over a month and the cleanser looks like it still has months and months left of use. I’m still working on finding something to help with my large pores/blackheads in my T-zone, but the cluster and cystic acne has stopped altogether!Hope this helps someone with skin similar to mine!
sentiment_label_note: Trained on rating-derived weak labels; not human-verified ground truth.

sku_or_module: Youth To The People - Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
redacted_text: I rarely if ever write reviews because I pass through products so quickly. i jump from cleanser to cleanser, never really finding a “good” one. My oily skin is so finnicky and many cleansers feel like they do NOTHING! I thought at first, this was just meh. It cleaned my skin and made it clear... so what? But that mind set changed when I decided to use a different cleanser and follow my routine of switching up constantly. My skin started getting pimples in the one place I hated: my forehead. My sensitive, acne prone forehead that is already sheltered by my bangs. I couldn’t believe it! My forehead was always so soft and smooth, so when it breaks out i KNOW something is off. At first, I thought that “no, i’m just purging!” but it just got worse... so i pulled this guy out again. Oh man... within ONE USE my skin was calm, less red, and already some of the acne was started to disappear. I couldn’t truly believe some “boring” cleanser without all of the pretty and cutesy frills that I love cleared up and kept my skin smooth. I was astonished by how much my skin actually liked this product! I do enjoy the beauty of products like Drunk Elephant (i use Protini along with this and no joke... glass skin!) but this cleanser is amazing. However I will be honest and say that I do get weekly extractions for black heads since this doesn’t prevent them or help them out much. If you have oily, acne prone skin and feel like you’ve been searching through a sea of “meeehhh” products, TRY THIS! Trust me, it looks like every other cleanser but it honestly makes my skin look like i’m using 1000  products. I’ve never received compliments on my skin until I started using this product.
sentiment_label_note: Trained on rating-derived weak labels; not human-verified ground truth.

sku_or_module: Koh Gen Do - Cleansing Spa Water Cloths
redacted_text: I saw this product but was hesitant to make the purchase not just because of the price, but I’ve bought similar products that were ineffective or just horrible. When I saw this was a sample - I grabbed it! I am [REDACTED_NAME], so glad I did!First the Cloth ~ I measured this cloth to be 7.5 by 6.5 inches. That’s a pretty good size since some of the other products I’ve bought were much smaller. This cloth is certified orangic and 100% pure cotton. It has to be the [REDACTED_NAME]FTEST cloth I’ve ever felt or used. And it is thick, thicker then any other cloth I’ve used. And after all your face has some of the softest skin on your body so you want something that is soft tuching it. The cloth didn’t rip, tear, or even look like it was going to come apart.I love that it has 6 Essential Oils - they protect your face and nurture at the same time. The Birch Sap is a wonderful moisturizer and retains moisture in your skin. The water itself is mineral rich from a hot spring in Japan. There’s no petroleum mineral oil, no fragrances or artifical coloring. The perfect combination to clean and moisturize your skin!I read a review that says there’s nothing but Parabens in this product. The ingredients are, and I’m reading them off of the packet itself.... Water, 6 Essential Oils of Rosemary, Sage, Lavender, Olive, Ginger, and Papaya Leaf Extracts, Birch Sap - a moisture retaine, Peg-7 which are fatty acids that come from Coconut Oil- a conditioner, Dipropylene Glycol - a combination of 3 isomeric compounds which combine to make a solvent - which is what dissolves your makeup! Stearamidopropyl Dimethylamine which is a leading “replacement“ for Silicone, Lactic Acid which adjusts acidity and as a disinfectant, AND Methylparaben which is “in“ the Paraben family and is used in cosmetics as a preservative. Glycerin which is a Humectant, which means it helps seal in moisture and also helps to enhance the cleaning aspect of a product. And Amino Acids which are the “building blocks“ of protein. And they make up 75% of our bodies and is essential to just about every fiunction of our body.I feel people should investigate ingredients before they make a purchase if they are worried about what’s in it! I would never put anything on my face that could harm it. I used to make bath and body products so I know how important the ingredients play in the purchase of a product. There HAS to be an ingredient <a paraben> that will preserve the product or it will go bad within a month, maybe sooner, maybe longer. Nobody wants to spend money on a product that they HAVE to use in 30 days or you have to toss it. But just because it has a paraben ingredient in it does not make it bad.That said, everyone is entitled to use whatever they want, it is their skin afterall.After all I’ve said ~ I gve this product 10 stars. It took my makeup, even waterproof, completely off my face without any irritation to my skin or eyes. These Spa Cloths made my skin feel better then anyting I’ve ever used. sku_or_module: Murad - Mini Acne Control Clarifying Cleanser
redacted_text: This cleanser is most certainly a product that takes getting used to. The first time I had gotten this product I was 20 It was a 100 point perk and it was such a great deluxe size bottle but I’m not gonna lie, I was brand new to fighting acne, I had blemishes in my teens but not acne! So when I first used the cleanser I wasn’t quite so disciplined into a skin care routine, I used it a couple times and tossed it aside convinced it was hoax or it was just too annoying to follow up with.For month’s I was blindly battling acne, I was slowly drifting away from my friends, I never wanted to work. I just felt so ugly.I really started experimenting, it was always something that claimed to be instant. I tried benzol peroxide, sulfurs and many products that like Murad have “Salicylic acid“ and I never got results my skin would get dry.I don’t know what made me pick my cleanser up but I started using it again after multiple recommendations that I for the longest time ignored. I used it once it the morning and again at night after completely removing my makeup (make sure you completely remove your makeup) and slowly I seen the changes, over about 2-3 weeks I seen smaller pores, my skin wasn’t as red and my blemishes didn’t hurt as bad. I learned that I needed a moisturizer and after about 2 months my skin completely had a very huge turn around.One thing I’ve learned is that treating acne takes time. The ingredients are really well researched, what I love when I use this cleanser is how you feel it refresh into your pores, the medicine is time released in little micro capsules so your skin is always protected.

product_name: Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
sku_or_module: Sunday Riley - Good Genes All-In-One AHA Lactic Acid Treatment
redacted_text: I have extremely sensitive skin, but also need exfoliation and resurfacing, so it was always a catch 22 for me because I need a H a treatment, especially a glycolic treatment, that was strong enough to be effective was also too strong and irritated my skin. But a more dilute formula that didn’t irritate my skin also wasn’t strong enough to be effective.Sunday Riley’s Good Genes turned all of that previous experience on its head. I have never used a purely lactic acid treatment, only product that had both Glycolic and lactic acid’s. I now know that the reason glycolic acid is a more powerful AHA is also why it can be more irritating: it’s a smaller molecule which can therefore penetrate deeper. Since lactic acid is not as strong as glycolic acid, my sensitive skin can tolerate a stronger application of lactic acid, allowing it to do its resurfacing work.In conclusion, in a very short period of time my skin feels totally renewed, smooth, and yet not irritated. I strongly recommend using Good Genes in conjunction with Luna night oil. My skin tolerates morning and evening applications of Good Genes; in the morning I put it on over a vitamin C serum and in the evenings I put it on over Luna facial oil.

sku_or_module: Origins - Clear Improvement Pore Clearing Moisturizer with Salicylic Acid
redacted_text: I’ve been using this for a little over a week now and I’m actually really impressed with it. It has an herbal, minty scent without being overpowering and an almost slight cooling effect on my skin. Origins Clear Improvement moisturizer absorbs quickly and dries to a relatively matte finish. I definitely have a bit of dryness with my combo skin, but I also experience the occasional breakouts along my jaw. This product immediately made a difference in the breakout I’d been suffering through, and it didn’t dry my skin out more, even with the salicylic acid. That being said, it wasn’t quite moisturizing enough for me to be the sole moisturizer I use. I’ve started doing a light layer at night with a bit of a heavier sleeping mask (currently using Algenist Genius Sleeping Collagen for a boost of dewy glow and extra hydration) over the top of Origins at night, and just a dab of this in the morning with a lightweight moisturizing primer over the top before makeup. If you have oily, acne prone skin, this will be a lifesaver, as I do feel it mattifies your skin a bit and works really well to settle inflamed breakouts and prevent new blemishes from forming. It would be a 5 stars for me if it was just a little more moisturizing, but it will definitely stay in the rotation! I received this product complimentary for testing purposes and my unbiased review.

It didn’t clear my skin completely but I expected that because it’s not “an acne treatment“ moisturizer but it did clear up my acne scars, clarity of my skintone, and did help clear most of my cystic acne. So, it gets five stars from me!

sku_or_module: PMD - Clean Pro Rose Quartz
redacted_text: I received this as a Christmas gift and have been in love with it ever since! I am 20 with light combination skin. I’ve been having trouble with clogged pores on my nose, dryness around lower cheeks and brow bone, and random pimples here and there. After my first use, the pores on my nose were practically erased! When I woke up the next morning, my clogged pores were back and I used the device again to get rid of them. The next day I woke up, there were significantly less clogged pores on my nose. Every time I use this device my skin looks smoother and clearer. To be honest, it’s given me a lot more confidence in my skin; so much so that I don’t even wear foundation anymore! I’ve heard some people say that their skin purges from using this product but, fortunately, I haven’t seen too much in terms of acne. As far as the rose quartz stone goes, it really helps my serums/ oils absorb more smoothly and evenly. I don’t know how well heating the stone works on my skin but if anything, it sure feels nice. It’s definitely pricey and I probably wouldn’t have bought it myself but if you can, I’d completely recommend it as I think it’s a great investment for your skin!

sku_or_module: Youth To The People - Superberry Dream Cleansing Balm
redacted_text: My 30’s skin had been looking haggard and nothing I used in my skincare routine seemed to make a difference. I washed my face with La Roche Posay only and sometimes felt it wasn’t strong enough to remove my SPF. I took the plunge with double cleansing to see if it would make a difference in my skin’s appearance. Well, since I’ve started using this balm, my skin has been feeling supple, hydrated and looking more even. I use it as a stand alone and as part of a double cleanse, depending on my mood. Although it does have a crumble like consistency, it easily softens into a thick paste in your hands so it’s easy to apply. I love using it to remove my SPF, and the milk-like residue rinses off well enough on its own so that a double cleanse is not necessary. I do have oily/dry and eczema/acne prone skin and this has been a very gentle cleanser that has not created any irritation or acne since I’ve started about 2 weeks ago. I highly recommend for those who want to get all the gunk out and want supple skin afterwards!
sentiment_label_note: Trained on rating-derived weak labels; not human-verified ground truth.

sku_or_module: Drunk Elephant - Pekee Cleansing Bar
redacted_text: This is [REDACTED_NAME]. It’s now my favorite cleanser.... a bar... of soap... is my favorite thing for my face. But my skin doesn’t lie. This bar soap feels so freaking amazing on my hands when I moisten it, lather, and WONDERFUL on my face. It doesn’t take much water or lathering of the bar itself to get enough on your hands for a thorough cleanse- which was surprising for me btw. And the bar doesn’t necessarily stay super moist after, just dripping product down into the soap dish. It actually kind of dries up quickly and gives you the piece of mind that it’s not a waste of product... That was my main concern with my first purchase of this (and JuJu)... that it would feel like a waste. And it’s not at all.Secondly, I was concerned that it would be [REDACTED_NAME] and messy to cleanse with a soap bar. I mean, who even does that anymore? I don’t even use bar soap for my hands unless it’s that spa stuff at a fancy hotel. In some [REDACTED_NAME] way, cleansing with this soap doesn’t feel awkward. The soap, like mentioned above, is super soft and feels so unbelievably nourishing on your face. My face doesn’t feel like it’s just been soap-stripped. In fact, it almost feels like I’ve actually just moisturized recently (without the residue). I absolutely love this. I actually get excited to use my Pekee bar (and the JuJu). As long as DE keeps this product the way it is, I can’t see a reason why I’ve ever change out my cleanser now. I’d recommend this to anyone who wants to take a chance on a bar of soap again.

When you buy a bottle of an exfoliating toner I think it would go much further than just 60 uses. Presoaked pads are also more wasteful than just applying a toner with your hands, although the convenience factor is nice.

redacted_text: You have to understand that I have tried so many chapsticks, lip balms, lip scrubs, blah blah blah that it’s not funny. I’m not always a good girl about brushing my teeth before I go to bed, but I tell myself that if I do, this lip sleeping mask is my reward.  If I don’t brush at night or at least floss and use mouthwash, then I’m not allowed to have any lip sleeping mask.  Well guess what? This mask is so good that I’m either brushing or mouthwashing EVERY NIGHT just so I can put this on.  It comes with a silicone applicator and you just scrap up a little and rub on your lips. I’ve never ever used anything like this, and I’ll never be without it again.  So glad I read the reviews and purchased.

sku_or_module: Glow Recipe - Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Sunscreen SPF 50
redacted_text: Disclaimer: I paid for this product. Scent: Scents tend to make me itchy but this scent was very mild- I just would like to know what ingredients entail “fragrance.”  It dissipates quickly. Pilling: I found that it pills mildly with products underneath that do not moisturize enough, could make flakes worse.Texture/Spread/Finish: It’s harder to spread if you have dryer skin or use products with cetyl alcohol (a wax alcohol). The dew barely lasted and my skin looked dry as the day went. Additionally the dew is best for smooth and young skin as it highlights wrinkles and texture. I wish that w/ dewy products, formulators took fine lines and skin texture into consideration. 30+ adults can be profitable clients too. Also, please consider men use skincare too.  Eyes: Unfortunately yes, it irritated my eyes often! I was surprised. sku_or_module: Drunk Elephant - C-Firma Fresh Vitamin-C Day Serum
redacted_text: I truly love this product SO MUCHI’ve been looking for a good vitamin c serum to purchase for a while, but I was nervous to purchase this one because of the price tag and some of the lower reviews. The vitamin c I was using prior didn’t contain any l-ascorbic acid, which is not a good thing if you actually want the vitamin c to absorb into your cells, and since this one contains the recommended 15%, I decided to take a chance. And oh, was it worth it. I assumed this would be one of those things that helped over time, but wouldn’t do much instantly. So when I saw myself in a mirror a few hours later and my skin was glowing and my dark undereye circles were noticeably lighter, I was shocked. The container is opaque, which is great because vitamin C is very unstable and I appreciate that it protects the product from light. I loved mixing it myself since it means this will stay potent longer. Some people say it’s hard to pour, but I didn’t think so. Before pouring in the serum, tap the powder container on a hard surface a few times to unstick it from the bottom of the container. This is [REDACTED_NAME] I did, and I didn’t have any powder stuck at the bottom after I poured in the serum and shook it for a minute. This product doesn’t have any added scent, so I can understand how someone might be really sensitive to smells and not like that. However, the fact that it is unscented is great for your skin, and its natural scent doesn’t smell bad to me: I might compare the smell to something like baby powder or baking soda. It’s not overpowering in my opinion. The worst part is that it’s a little sticky, but for me, personally, that’s not a problem. I don’t wear makeup most days, so I’m willing to deal with a little bit of a sticky product when it’s this good. Plus, because it adds so much brightness to my skin / under-eyes, I feel even less inclined to wear makeup

product_name: Retinol Fast-Release Wrinkle Reducing Night Serum
sku_or_module: Kiehl's Since 1851 - Retinol Fast-Release Wrinkle Reducing Night Serum
redacted_text: Separating the formula to keep it fresh until you’re ready to start using it is a unique & fantastic idea. You’re basically guaranteed a fresh product by mixing & activating the serum yourself so, you can stock up worry-free if you wish. I wish I would have recorded the simple-to-follow steps that are pictured on the back of the box to show the process of mixing my first bottle! It was fun! You may have to shake multiple times before the serum doesn’t feel gritty anymore.You only need about a pea-sized amount to cover your entire face, I use a bit more for down my neck area but you don’t want to feel drenched or covered in a layer of this serum. I like to rub a small amount between my middle & ring fingers on each hand, spread a little in various areas then gently press it into my skin. The formula spreads nicely & absorbs quickly, just remember not to overdo it, this is [REDACTED_NAME] and it doesn’t take much. I saw results after just one night! My skin was clearer, brighter, more even & looked firmer after just one use. I have been using this for a few weeks now & I’m speechless about the results I’m seeing. My fine lines are practically gone & my skin has never looked better at 37! If you’re new or sensitive to retinol then slowly work your way up to using this serum every night or every other night by taking a night or two off, just listen to your skin. If you start feeling any irritation or see your skin is getting too dry to the point it hurts, use a nice nourishing moisturizer, balm, and/or leave-on hydrating face mask in between uses. Don’t destroy your moisture barrier hoping for faster results. This is [REDACTED_NAME] over-the-counter retinol I have used & while I am [REDACTED_NAME] results already, I have been using retinol products & other chemical exfoliants for years. I’ve learned to listen to my skin & take breaks when necessary. Don’t forget to always apply & reapply SPF throughout the day light hours.

sku_or_module: CLINIQUE - Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel
redacted_text: There are users who absolutely swear by this product (or its oil-inclusive sister, Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion), but for me it just didn’t make the grade.  Clinique’s Three-Step Skincare was my first attempt at regular, attentive skin treatment as an adolescent.  It certainly improved over nothing, but it didn’t hold up and I looked elsewhere for more targeted teenage-acne help.  Later, once my skin had mellowed, I returned, and it still just isn’t enough.It provides mild hydration without slicking skin (like the Lotion can).  But even though I’m prone to oiliness, the inclusion of some oil in my skincare prevents the skin from feeling over-dried and keeps it from over-producing oil in response.For those this works for, that’s great, but I suspect that most users will find much better success (and much more comprehensive benefits) from other moisturizing products.

I would be very very careful with this eye cream and if puffy balls of fluid start accumulating under your eyes while using it, please know it is this eye cream and very likely not something else.

sku_or_module: Sunday Riley - Luna Sleeping Retinoid Night Oil
redacted_text: I am 54 years old & have used prescription Retin-A (both the low dose & the highest dose) for years on & off. I’ve tried everything new as it comes out thru the years and Retin A definitely works and I personally can see a very noticeable difference in my skin after just one Overnight application when I return to using this product after taking a break from it for months or even years. Retin A works great but many people don’t/can’t  stick with it due to the side-effect of peeling skin which is very hard to deal with when it comes to trying to apply your makeup over. Those dry patches and peeling flakes standout like a spotlight once makeup is applied over them. I received a sample vial of Luna Oil in one of my beauty subscription boxes. Luna oil seems to be one of the very, very few over-the-counter (non-prescription) retinoids that I can actually see an overnight difference with but with the perk of it not causing such severe peeling and flaking if the skin. The oil seems to greatly temper that ugly side-effect yet you still are able to notice a benefit. It’s pricey but Rx Retin-A costs around $300 a tube nowadays if not covered by your insurance plan. I like the fresh herbal scent of this product; however, do not be fooled...the blue tint is from the addition of blue & purple dye. Read the ingredients. I find the addition of extra dye added to my skincare totally unnecessary and undesirable. I very much like this product and would certainly consider buying a full-size if it didn’t contain artificial coloring. I realize tons of makeup does, but why compound that by adding it where it’s totally unnecessary & undesired? Adding it to eyeshadows, blush & Foundation? Understandable & unavoidable. Adding it to a product I just use while I’m asleep and no one is seeing me? Totally not required or desired. I will keep a watch on this item and see if they ever remove the dye and then I would decide to purchase it. I deducted 1 star purely on the addition of said dye.

redacted_text: Today I wanted to review Ferulic Brew Rejuvenating Facial Essence which is a wonderful product from @kiehls that I received complimentary in exchange for my honest opinions.Details: This essence is formulated for all skin types & has antioxidants that assist in removal of dull skin. Essence comes out clear with a brown tint, watery with a lovely herbal scent. A little goes a long way & only a few drops are needed to cover your face & neck. This does an excellent job preparing my skin for future skincare steps. It gives my skin a healthy glow, adds a nice base layer of moisture & layers well with other products. I’ve experienced no skin sensitivity to daily use of this product. Does not leave a tacky film & served well when my skin was drier in San Francisco. Overall: This is a great facial essence that works well for my oily skin & even when my skin became dry in San Francisco. It adds moisture, leaves my skin glowing & prepped for future skin care steps. It retails for 52.00 for 6.8 fl oz which is pricy but it works very well for me & will last a long time.

I’m definitely going to be buying up the rest of the line.

product_name: Truth Barrier Booster Orange Ferment Vitamin C Essence
sku_or_module: OLEHENRIKSEN - Truth Barrier Booster Orange Ferment Vitamin C Essence
redacted_text: I was gifted this product by Ole Henriksen in exchange for my honest review. I have some mixed feelings about this one. On one hand, it has really nice ingredients - lactobacillus ferment, niacinamide, polyglutamic acid, gluconolactone, panthenol, seaweed and a vitamin c derivative. It’s very hydrating and I do think it has the potential to brighten the skin. However, it’s very heavily fragranced (smells like an orange creamsicile) and I don’t think it will work well for sensitive skin types. Citrus essential oils can be some of the most irritating ingredients. So while it is working for me and I haven’t had any issues, I would proceed with caution if you are sensitive.

product_name: Banana Bright+ Vitamin C Eye Crème
sku_or_module: OLEHENRIKSEN - Banana Bright+ Vitamin C Eye Crème
redacted_text: I actually like this eye cream a lot more than I thought I would. I have very sensitive, dehydrated skin. The texture is thick and rich, and moisturizes well without being too heavy for me. It did not sting my skin, which is a problem I run into frequently. It has a slight orange tint, which does give an instant brightening effect on top of the dewy finish. It wears beautifully under makeup. It does not come with a spatula, but I would recommend using one (I used one that came with another product of mine). I did take off a star because I don’t think eye cream is 100% necessary and the price is rather high for something that I don’t think has any significant long-term benefits compared to a cheaper/standard moisturizing eye product. That said, a little bit goes a long way so think this little jar will last quite a long time for the price. If you’re in the market specifically for an eye cream, I do recommend this. Even though it’s a bit of a luxury item, I will likely still purchase it with my own money just because the formula is lovely and I enjoy using it. Do keep in mind that vitamin c isn’t very shelf-stable, so even if the jar lasts a long time, the vitamin c in it won’t.

redacted_text: I wanted to use this for a couple weeks before writing a review. I’ve been wanting to try the True Botanicals Renew radiance oil, but this one is more than half the cost and works phenomenally.  So give it a try! product_name: The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
sku_or_module: Tatcha - The Dewy Skin Cream Plumping & Hydrating Moisturizer
redacted_text: This is a great moisturizer.  Its description says normal to dry skin, but this can even be used on oily skins like myself.  I normally use the water cream, but I really wanted to try this to be extra nourishing to my skin which is acne prone.  While my skin is very oily, it still needs to be moisturized so it won’t overproduce oil.  Anyways, this is a beautiful moisturizer.  It takes a good five to ten minutes to sink into the skin, while the water cream is almost instantly sunk in.  This also leaves a beautifully radiant skin like it claims, without looking oily like my face can be.  Its definitely dewy looking in a good way and looks its best either without makeup or under any foundation that is not matte.  You can use this with matte foundation with this to be extra nourishing, but you will not see the dewy look the way you would with other foundations. This does not trigger my acne and is not too heavy.  However, less is definitely more with this moisturizer.  You hardly need any to moisturize your entire face.  I use about half the amount of this compared to water cream (like 1-2 grains of rice literally).  From least hydrating to most hydrating from Tatcha is: Water Cream, Dewy Cream, Indigo Cream, Silk Cream, Luminous Dewy Cream. Comparing this to the dewy mist, this cream sinks into the skin much better and leaves a much more natural, long lasting, dominate raidiant dewy skin look.  I’m very happy with this purchase and if you have dry skin, you can save yourself quiet a bit of money by purchasing this instead of the silk cream.  (the indigo is barely more heavy than the dewy cream, but is specifically designed for those with sensitive skins and does not have a dewy skin look).  I also think this is a must-try if you really strive for “no-makeup“ makeup looks.  This is [REDACTED_NAME] way to give you that naturally glowing, healthy skin look.
sentiment_label_note: Trained on rating-derived weak labels; not human-verified ground truth.

I have combination skin with a T-zone that gets oily by mid-day and cheeks/jawline that is sometimes too dry; I also don’t usually break out.The 1st day, I applied a few drops of the Argan Milk to my cleansed face before bed followed by my moisturizer. Since the product description labels this as a serum, I used it accordingly (face cleanser, toner, serum, then moisturizer). On the 2nd day, in the the morning my face felt hydrated and I didn’t notice any massive breakouts, so I followed the suggested use (for day and night), applying it again that morning. It does leave a light greasy film though so maybe it’s best used only at night. At the end of the 2nd day before bed, after washing my face, I sat in front of my mirror getting ready to apply my skincare products when I noticed little whiteheads all over my chin, under my nose and along my upper lip... It wasn’t noticeable until I examined my face closely, but literally ALL of the pores in the aforementioned places had tiny raised bumps as if something was trying to escape from my pores! I have tried one or two other face oils in the past without breaking out, but this oil completely clogged my pores and some of the many whiteheads became larger pimples.That being said, once in a while when I try a new cleanser or toner, I might start breaking out a little before my skin regulates, but I can understand that with a cleanser or toner because those work to extract dirt and oil which sometimes can cause the face to overproduce oil or it just brings all that stuff that was clogging your pores to the surface, initially causing some pimples until it cleans everything out. However, I don’t believe a serum/moisturizer should ever cause breakouts!! :(

sku_or_module: Origins - High-Potency Night-a-Mins Resurfacing Cream with Fruit-Derived AHAs
redacted_text: I’ve never been much of a night cream person but as I approach my mid-thirties, my skin is showing signs of needing a boost. My Mom is an Origins fan and has remarkably youthful, vibrant skin at age 65. During a recent visit I kept complimenting her on her glowing complexion and how amazing her skin looked even in harsh department store lighting. She told me that she’d been using Night-A-Mins for about 3 weeks and much to my delight, she picked up a tub for me! I’ve only been using it for a week and half but I’m definitely impressed. The texture is rich and silky, not heavy and oily like some creams. The fragrant ingredients are also lovely. My skin, normal but prone to some hormonal breakouts, is smoother and calmer since I started using Night-A-Mins. Several women have asked what I was doing differently with makeup or if I was taking some new supplement or getting professional treatments. This cream is the real deal; I’m certainly not the girl who gets compliments on “a glowing complexion“ at 8am! I’d recommend trying this product unless your skin is very sensitive or you prefer unscented products. I found the smell dissipated rather quickly though.For [REDACTED_ORDER_ID], the only night creams that have really impressed me are Hope in a Jar Night and Dior Capture Totale (which I could never afford!). Korres Sleeping Facials seem like fantastic products for those with dryer skin. They were just a bit heavy for my skin type.

sku_or_module: Youth To The People - Mini Superfood Antioxidant Cleanser
redacted_text: So, I never thought I would spend 36$ on a face wash. I love face washes that come with cotton pads because I feel they really get the dirt off of my face better than just my hands (and I’m also too lazy to use my Clairsonic because I feel like I have to clean my face and that thing). But I had to hunt for a new face wash after I realized that Aveeno stopped making their Positively Radiant cleansing pads and every store now only carries their version with salicylic acid in them. I just wanted a plain face wash with ZERO acids in it. It seems like everything has acids in it for some reason and my skin just can’t handle it. I’m sick of my facing stinging when I wash it plus I wash my face morning and night (by night I mean when I get off from work) and I just can’t keep putting acids on my face that often (I don’t mean ascorbic acid either-I’m talking AHA/BHA/SA etc). Well, I found this and I’m so glad that I did because 1. it cleansed my face so good using just my hands and didn’t sting or burn my eyes at all 2. the soap lathers really really good so a little goes a long way (which helps me feel better about the price) 3. my face didn’t immediately feel tight or dry when I smiled after washing my face instead it actually felt soft, plump and moisturized which I have never experienced after washing my face and 4. IT SMELLS SO GOOD! It smells like kale with a shot of chlorophyll but somehow delicious. It just makes me feel like my skin is drinking a green smoothie without fruit! I know it’s crazy but I feel super healthy using this face wash! I also love the glass jar because F plastic. The only downside is that I picked this up in Sephora and my box didn’t come with a pump so I just pour a little in my hand which I hope won’t translate to me pouring too much. It’s no biggie since I see so many reviews complaining about the pump. I hope it’s not difficult to pour this out of the jar once it starts getting to the bottom. Also my face oil absorbed really good with this.

redacted_text: I feel strange giving this product a mediocre review, because it performs as promised, but the form it comes in doesn’t work with the packaging at all. The product photo looks like it’s a thick cream or putty texture, or even a light mousse, but the jar I got is liquid. If you tilt the jar, it runs out. It gets all over the inner lid liner. The photo shows it holding the shape of a swirl, presumably as the product was dispensed into the jar, but the real product could never hold a shape. It needs to be stored on a flat surface, or it will flow out and make a big mess. Conversely, it also dries out in the jar very quickly, but not in a way that makes it at all easier to work with.Because of the fluidity, it’s difficult to work with, and not get too much on the brush. This product should have either been made denser, like a more traditional concealer, or come in a tube with a narrow tip.That said, I like what it does. It’s quite opaque, and neutralizes and covers the redness on my cheeks very well. I just wish it was not so easy to spill and waste.

sku_or_module: Josie Maran - Argan Pro-Retinol Eye Cream
redacted_text: I had the opportunity to try a sample of this eye cream before the official launch, and I must say, I’m impressed! I have combination skin but it’s currently dehydrated because of indoor heating, so I like to use products that can help trap moisture but at the same time aren’t too heavy or greasy, and this eye cream fits the bill. The packaging says it contains retinol, but it’s actually the weakest derivative - Retinyl Palmitate, which is gentle enough to use even during the day (you can sometimes find it in sunscreens). Although it’s not super intensive for anti-aging you might still see some improvement to fine lines over time, and it’s better to use this one than no retinoid at all. This would be a nice introductory product for retinol beginners in their 20s!

sku_or_module: The Ordinary - Squalane Cleanser
redacted_text: I love this stuff so much I started enjoying double-cleansing again after taking a year’s hiatus. I’ve been double-cleansing for YEARS - before it was really a “thing“ in the beauty world - and I’ve used everything from straight up carrier oils to cleansing balms. Though, I stopped double-cleansing because I felt it a pain in the butt to have to over-rinse to remove residue or oiliness, which would cause my dry skin to become even dryer and tight...  and that’s why this is [REDACTED_NAME]. The creamy product turns to silky emollient upon application, and rinses away like nothing. It removes even my most stubborn makeup effortlessly and within seconds, and without needing to scrub hard or for long. Meaning, this added step hardly feels like an additional step in my multi-step skincare routine. For best results: I do recommend applying on dry skin, and gradually apply wet fingers to the eye area to remove makeup, and rinse with a cloth and water... Not just water alone.  I’ve read reviews complaining about leftover mascara residue -- but I just don’t understand it. The first time I used this I was floored at how it removed ALL traces of my makeup with such ease. I could’ve carried on without double-cleansing. And it’s never let me down since. It even seems to be helping with my pores and sebaceous filaments. Though it’s not an instant fix. Overall, it’s effective, hydrating, gentle, easy-to-use. I’m not sure what more one could want. My biggest gripe is that the smaller bottle doesn’t last long, as sometimes you need a little more product than you’d think, but for the price, I can’t really complain. Its competitors are 3x the price for a subpar product. Farmacy’s got nothing on The [REDACTED_ORDER_ID]. Even K-beauty should take note. Another one knocked out of the park!

redacted_text: I have to say, this is [REDACTED_NAME] stuff. sku_or_module: Sunday Riley - Mini C.E.O. Vitamin C Brightening Rich Hydration Moisturizer
redacted_text: I was very skeptical about this product after reading mixed reviews but decided to give it a shot anyway. I have normal skin, a little on the dry side. Wasn’t in desperate need of a new day cream but I love SR’s other products so I wanted to try this too.First of all, I noticed some people were really aggressive in their reviews supporting this product, almost to the point of bullying. You don’t need to read Paula’s Choice to know that a product will last longer and avoid being exposed to bacteria if it comes with an air tight pump dispenser. It’s just common sense. I personally love the luxurious feeling of dipping my finger into a jar of cream and spreading it on my skin. BUT: your hands don’t need to be “dirty“ (as some very polite reviewers said) to contaminate a jarred product. You could have other products (cleanser, serum, etc.) on your finger and that could get mixed with the cream. ANYWAY!So I personally love the texture of this product, it’s so creamy but not greasy. The smell is fine, doesn’t bother me but I could do without it. Feels great on my skin and absorbs quickly without leaving any residue, just soft skin.THAT BEING SAID: 3 months is a very short shelf life for this product. If you are going to use it every day then it would probably be fine. If you’re like me and like to switch it up then you are probably going to have a lot of product going to waste. I think that Fresh Lotus Youth Preserve is a better choice.
sentiment_label_note: Trained on rating-derived weak labels; not human-verified ground truth.
